desc:
The MAWL-C1+ is the world’s first commercially available near-infrared (NIR) and visible green laser aiming device that uses Class 1+™ technology. It is the civilian-legal version of the MAWL platform.

It is widely regarded as one of the highest-performing commercial weapon-mounted IR aiming/illumination lasers available, prized for its beam quality, illumination range under night-vision, and user-friendly ergonomics.
